connect.title: Connect to your server
connect.lede: Budget Owl runs on your household's own server, and this app talks only to it. Enter the address you open Budget Owl at in a browser.
connect.addressHint: It starts with https:// — ask whoever set the server up if you are not sure.
connect.connectedLede: This is a Budget Owl server. What would you like to do?
connect.setUpHint: Nobody has an account on this server yet. The first account you create becomes its owner.
connect.problem.invalid: That doesn't look like a server address.
connect.problem.cleartext: That address starts with http://, so your password and balances would cross the network unencrypted. Budget Owl connects only over HTTPS.
connect.problem.cleartextHelp: The user guide's page “Give your server an HTTPS address” shows three ways to do it.
connect.problem.path: Enter just the server's address, with nothing after its name — no /api and no other path.
connect.problem.credentials: Take the user name and password out of the address. You sign in on the next screen.
connect.problem.query: Enter just the server's address, without a ? or # part.
connect.error.hostNotFound: No server answers to that name. Check the spelling, and that this phone is on a network that can reach it.
connect.error.unreachable: The server didn't answer. It may be switched off, or not reachable from the network this phone is on.
connect.error.certificateUntrusted: This phone doesn't trust the server's certificate, so Budget Owl sends nothing to it. If your server uses its own certificate authority, install that authority on this phone, then try again.
connect.error.certificateWrongName: The server's certificate is for a different name than the one you entered. Use the name on the certificate, or fix the certificate.
connect.error.notBudgetOwl: Something answered at that address, but it isn't a Budget Owl server.
connect.error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a minute.
connect.error.versionMismatch: This server's API is version {server}, and this app needs version {app}. Update whichever is older, then try again.
connect.error.transport: The connection to the server failed part-way. Try again.
login.deviceLabelHint: Shown on your devices list, so you can tell which phone to sign out.
login.passwordLoginDisabled: This server has turned off signing in with an email and password, and the app can only sign in that way for now. Sign in on the web instead.
join.pasteHint: The link you were sent. It starts with this server's address and has /join/ in it.
join.problem.notALink: That isn't an invitation link. It should be this server's address followed by /join/ and a long code.
join.problem.otherHost: That invitation is for {host}, not the server you entered. Change the server first if you meant that one.
join.existingAccount: I already have an account on this server
noHousehold.bodyPhone: You are signed in, but nobody has added you to a household. Ask the person who runs this server for an invitation link, then paste it on the connect screen.
accounts.archiveMessagePhone: It keeps its history, hides it from lists, and stops taking new transactions. You can bring it back whenever you like.
more.title: More
more.changeServerMessage: You'll be signed out of {host}, and everything Budget Owl keeps on this phone is erased. Your household's data stays on the server.
more.signOutMessage: Everything Budget Owl keeps on this phone is erased. Your household's data stays on the server.
placeholder.body: This screen is coming to the app in the next update. It works on the web today.
offline.write: You're offline — this needs a connection
offline.versionUnconfirmed: Changes are off until the server confirms it runs a version this app works with. Refresh to check again.
offline.noCopy: You're offline, and this phone has no saved copy of this yet.
offline.staleNoAnswer: Last updated {ago} — the server didn't answer
transactions.readOnlyRow: Your role in this household can read transactions but not change them.
devices.confirmMessagePhone: This is the phone you are using now. You will be signed out, and what Budget Owl keeps on it is erased.
privacy.hidden: Budget Owl is hidden while the app is in the background.
